entities.summary: SeatGeek Stadium is a soccer-specific stadium in Bridgeview, Illinois, about 12 miles southwest of downtown Chicago. It is the home stadium of Chicago Fire FC II of MLS Next Pro, the Chicago Hounds of Major League Rugby, and the Chicago State Cougars football team. The stadium has also hosted the Chicago Fire of Major League Soccer, Chicago Stars FC of the National Women's Soccer League, Chicago Machine of Major League Lacrosse, Chicago Bliss of the Legends Football League, Chicago State Cougars men's and women's soccer teams of NCAA Division I, and Chicago House AC of the National Independent Soccer Association.
